title: CJK text odt 001
notes: real CJK fixture: 静夜思 (Li Bai, Quiet Night Thought) as five CJK paragraphs, every CJK paragraph styled with the named paragraph style "GP CJK" whose text-properties set style:font-name-asian="Noto Serif CJK SC" plus fo:language="zh" fo:country="CN" (the asian font-name slot, not the latin fo:font-name). Honest caveat: one shared style tags zh/CN even in 002, so Japanese and Korean text are zh-tagged — font substitution for kana/Hangul is renderer-font dependent (Noto CJK covers all three scripts when installed). Reference text is the exact character strings; no normative ODF counter matches, feature counts stay 0.
